label: forest
brief: Fixed captures from the game of one Stormwood place (the Deepwood forest heart) from the gameplay camera: left, the storm in its Calm phase; middle, the storm at Break (lightning); right, the same place in the calm aftermath once the long storm has ended (lighter rain, no lightning, strike scars). Judge how this place looks in the game - whether it reads as the key art's Stormwood (fixed purple storm sky, cool blue-green moss, copper and glass highlights, black pools, white-violet lightning), with believable form, material, light and staging in each state.
defects: Flat magenta rings or slabs, placeholder materials, floating bodies or clipping remain in the frame matrix
